'''Halron Yehr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] assault leader. He and two other of his fellow stormtroopers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operative dispatched by Captain [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="SWG:TtY" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Halron Yehr was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtY" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Halron Yehr was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:TtY" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
